title: Snyk Container Project Structure
description: JSON Structure documentation for Snyk Container scanning project data model

fields.name: id
fields.description: Unique project identifier in UUID format

fields.name: name
fields.description: Project name — typically the image name and tag (e.g. nginx:1.25-alpine)

fields.name: status
fields.description: Whether the project is actively monitored

fields.name: created
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the project was created

fields.name: read_only
fields.description: Whether the project configuration can be modified

fields.name: tags
fields.description: User-defined key/value tags for organizing projects

fields.name: settings.recurring_tests.frequency
fields.description: How often Snyk automatically re-scans the container image
